title: Q1: Customer request
prompt: What does the customer ask for?

ja.prompt: お客様は何を求めていますか？

local.prompt: What does the customer ask for?

local_pron.prompt: Whut duhz thuh KUS-tuh-mer ask for?

en.prompt: What does the customer ask for?

en_pron.prompt: wʌt dʌz ðə ˈkʌstəmər æsk fɔr?

title: Q2: Calm before transfer
prompt: What does the agent ask the customer to do before transfer?

ja.prompt: 転送する前に担当者はお客様に何を頼みますか？
ja.hint: 短い文（3語）：'Please calm down'（落ち着いてください）

local.prompt: What does the agent ask the customer to do before transfer?

local_pron.prompt: Whut duhz thee AY-jent ask thuh KUS-tuh-mer to do bee-for tranz-fer?

zh.prompt: 在轉接前，客服要求客戶做什麼？
zh.hint: 短句（3個字）：'Please calm down'（請冷靜）

en.prompt: What does the agent ask the customer to do before transfer?

en_pron.prompt: wʌt dʌz ði ˈeɪdʒənt æsk ðə ˈkʌstəmər tuː duː bɪˈfɔr trænsfər?

title: Q3: First step before escalating
prompt: If the customer asks to speak to a supervisor, what will the agent do first?
hint: Use the agent's words: 'Let me see how I can assist.'
sample: Let me see how I can assist.

ja.prompt: お客様が上司と話したいと言ったら、担当者はまず何をしますか？
ja.hint: 担当者の言葉を使って：'Let me see how I can assist.'（まず対応できるか確認する）
ja.sample: まず対応できるか確認します

local.prompt: If the customer asks to speak to a supervisor, what will the agent do first?
local.hint: Use the agent's words: 'Let me see how I can assist.'
local.sample: Let me see how I can assist.

local_pron.prompt: If thuh KUS-tuh-mer asks to speek to uh SOO-per-vy-zor, whut wil thuh AY-jent do fɜrst?
local_pron.hint: Use: 'Let mee see how I can uh-sist.'
local_pron.sample: Let mee see how I can uh-sist.

zh.prompt: 如果客戶要求與主管通話，客服會先做什麼？
zh.hint: 使用客服的原話：'Let me see how I can assist.'（先看看能否幫忙）

en.prompt: If the customer asks to speak to a supervisor, what will the agent do first?
en.hint: Use the agent's words: 'Let me see how I can assist.'
en.sample: Let me see how I can assist.

en_pron.prompt: ɪf ðə ˈkʌstəmər æsks tuː spiːk tuː ə ˈsuːpərˌvaɪzər, wʌt wɪl ði ˈeɪdʒənt duː fɜrst?
en_pron.hint: juːz ði ˈeɪdʒənts wɜrdz: 'lɛt mi siː haʊ aɪ kæn əˈsɪst.'
en_pron.sample: lɛt mi siː haʊ aɪ kæn əˈsɪst
